name: async-finalizer-context-getters
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture exercises the concrete local finalizer context through an attached queueable lifecycle; it grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

evidence.notes: The attached local finalizer context exposes its queueable job id.
The attached concrete local finalizer context exposes the same queueable job id.

source.content: public class FinalizerContextGetterFixture implements Queueable, Finalizer { public static String interfaceJobId; public static String implementationJobId; public void execute(QueueableContext context) { System.attachFinalizer(this); } public void execute(FinalizerContext context) { interfaceJobId = context.getAsyncApexJobId(); Object raw = context; System.FinalizerContextImpl implementation = (System.FinalizerContextImpl)raw; implementationJobId = implementation.getAsyncApexJobId(); } }

@IsTest private class FinalizerContextGetterFixtureTest { @IsTest static void attachedContextExposesJobId() { Test.startTest(); System.enqueueJob(new FinalizerContextGetterFixture()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertNotEquals('', FinalizerContextGetterFixture.interfaceJobId); System.assertEquals(FinalizerContextGetterFixture.interfaceJobId, FinalizerContextGetterFixture.implementationJobId); } }
